subset.rationale: absl::btree_map/btree_set bound HEAD-ON (the ordered half of BINDER-0008). The container_internal btree_map_container/btree_set_container/btree_container ancestry becomes the flattened/Python-base chain via reachability discovery; the heterogeneous query surface (contains/count/find/erase/at/equal_range/lower_bound/upper_bound and operator[] -> __getitem__ with C++ default-insert semantics) binds via default-instantiable member templates with the TC-0004 dispatch-level substitution. bttest supplies value-setting population (insert's pair<iterator,bool> return is not Python-expressible).
skipped_features: ordered ITERATION from Python (begin/lower_bound return iterator types; a future __iter__/make_iterator feature -- order is exercised natively in the oracle only)
emplace/try_emplace/insert_or_assign (parameter-pack member templates, skipped by design)
